newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Falvest issues profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Falvest issues profit warning.

text.p: Falcon Investments Societe Anonyme said on Monday the decline in the gold price had rendered some of its unit's operations unprofitable and forecasts made for the second half may not be achieved.
It also urged shareholders to exercise caution in their share dealings. Falvest said its unit Falcon Gold Zimbabwe Ltd was curtailing its unprofitable operations.
It said forecasts made in the interim report that it would achieve a gold programme of 1,321 kg in the second half and post a dividend of 20 U.S. cents were not expected to be achieved.
"In light of the above Falcon shareholders are similarly advised to exercise caution when dealing in Falcon shares," it said.
